description: Touch up the artist's own photo on one draft picture post, as Promo's Touch up: cut to the post's shape and given light, contrast, warmth and color by Audora's own renderer. No AI: the pixels stay the artist's. Saved as a new picture in the Library and put on the post (and on the other draft pictures of its moment); the photo it was made from stays. For a photo of the artist's own, never a video post. Costs 1 credit (the dry run says the price); the real call needs the artist's spend permission. dry_run first, tell the artist the price, then confirm_cost_credits.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

confirm_cost_credits.description: The price a dry run quoted and you told the artist. Required for the real call.

dry_run.description: True to see the price, changing nothing. Do this first and tell the artist.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

post_id.description: The post's id (post_id from get_campaign or promo_this_week).

name: touch_up
title: Touch up a post's photo
